say:1:1030112901:1.text: Although the dock in Holistone is small and run-down, it still functions. It's actually maintained every once in a while.
say:1:1030112901:1.source_cn: 圣石镇的码头设施虽然又小又旧，但不至于废弃，每隔一段时...

say:2:1030112902:1.text: However, there have been fewer merchant ships coming through lately. If no goods are unloaded here, that means no money!
say:2:1030112902:1.source_cn: 不过最近通商的商船数量减少了，没有卸货，就没钱赚！

say:3:1030112903:1.text: Barnacles! I shouldn't have said that... Let me tell you something. Those of us who depend on the sea for a living are a superstitious lot. They don't like to mention anything unlucky or taboo.
say:3:1030112903:1.source_cn: 唉，靠水吃饭的人讲究多，不吉利的话不让说，忌讳的话更不能说。

say:4:1030112904:1.text: So just forget what I said!
say:4:1030112904:1.male: So just forget what I said!
say:4:1030112904:1.female: So just forget what I said!
